title: Lylatul qadr ka tarjuma Fatima
body:
Lylatul qadr ka tarjuma Fatima
La fata kay khuda ka pata fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Sayyeda,Tahira,Raziya,Marziya
Hai yahi sub se bara tera qasida Zehra
Baap kehta hai tujhe Umme Abiha Zehra
Qul e eman ne parhi hai tere anchal pe namaz
Kyun na phir tujh ko kahun kabe ka kaaba Zehra
<<MINI>>
Lylatul qadr ka tarjuma Fatima
La fata kay khuda ka pata fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Anbiya ke hain mushkil khusha Murtaza
Murtaza ki hain mushkil khusha Fatima
Yeh na hoti to kuch bhi na hota kahin
Kun ka matlab hai kiya Fatima Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Fizza ki dehleez se mang ker
Moujize le gaye anbiya Fatima
Qabr e Masooma qom dikha di mujhe
Haq se pucha jo tera pata Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab bhi meraj ki dil mai khuwaish hui
Tere ghar agaye, Mustafa Fatima
Gasibon pe jo lanat nahu bhejta
Aesq beta hai kis kam ka Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum bhi parde mai thin kuch to waze karo
Aur meraj mai kiya hua Fatima
Ban rahy haun kad o khal Abbas ke
Hain musalle pe mehw e dua Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja ke dekho likha hai yeh tariqh mai
Kis se ho kr gayib hain khafa Fatima
Haq ki tareef likhni thi ik lafz mai
Bus taqallum ne phir likh dya Fatima
author: Mir Hassan Mir
